    # The 5 line separates two panels. Compare each marker's relative height
    # below versus above the divider; return a 2x2 block in the faster-growing
    # marker's color (ties favor 4, as in the demonstrations).
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    colors = [c for c in {v for row in grid for v in row} if c not in (0, 5)]
    colors.sort()
    above = grid[:divider]
    below = grid[divider + 1:]
    heights = {}
    for color in colors:
        heights[color] = (
            sum(any(v == color for v in row) for row in above),
            sum(any(v == color for v in row) for row in below),
        )
    c1, c2 = colors
    a1, b1 = heights[c1]
    a2, b2 = heights[c2]
    chosen = c1 if b1 * a2 > b2 * a1 else c2
    return [[chosen, chosen], [chosen, chosen]]
"
